title: Back up your vampires

canon_policy.notes: Kyra, Tesla, Valrr, the crystalline dragon, locations, plot events, and story cosmology remain source-bound. Only abstract interaction, embodiment, relay, state-transition, and sensory-interface mechanisms may cross into Universal Codex design.

mechanisms.name: facts-before-panic
mechanisms.description: A high-stress anomaly is first reconstructed as a sequence of concrete observations before interpretation or action expands.
mechanisms.codex_translation: When an unexpected state appears, Universal Codex should first surface what changed, where, when, and from which source before offering interpretation, escalation, or repair.

mechanisms.name: relay-bridged-presence
mechanisms.description: Presence can be extended through multiple relays by following a known endpoint and compensating for dead zones with alternate energy or carrier paths.
mechanisms.codex_translation: Represent multi-hop presence as an inspectable route with endpoint lock, dead-zone markers, fallback carriers, and receipts for each successful handoff.

mechanisms.name: consented-knowledge-transfer
mechanisms.description: Skill transfer occurs through explicit permission to access lived experience rather than requiring a separate manual or duplicate model.
mechanisms.codex_translation: Permit a user to grant a scoped tool or guide access to selected skill context, traces, or demonstrations, with visible scope and revocation rather than silent context absorption.

mechanisms.name: remote-embodiment-through-tool
mechanisms.description: A remote or nonlocal participant gains agency through a vehicle or machine while remaining distinct from that machine.
mechanisms.codex_translation: Allow a guide or agent to inhabit a tool form, room, ship, page, or projection organ while preserving separate identity, authority scope, and machine state.

mechanisms.name: embodiment-with-actuation
mechanisms.description: Embodied presence is meaningful because it can actuate real functions such as navigation, first-aid access, or system routing rather than merely appearing visually.
mechanisms.codex_translation: A manifested Codex presence should expose only the actions actually authorised for that form and report results through receipts.

mechanisms.name: layer-transition-with-reentry
mechanisms.description: Movement between physical, dreamlike, virtual, and embodied-machine states is experienced as a transition with re-entry effects rather than a hard scene cut.
mechanisms.codex_translation: Render threshold crossings as explicit transitions that preserve previous-state anchors and mark return-to-body or return-to-page state separately.

mechanisms.name: sensory-fidelity-gradient
mechanisms.description: A mediated environment can become progressively more vivid, crisp, embodied, and multisensory without that vividness changing its source class.
mechanisms.codex_translation: Track sensory fidelity independently from epistemic class so a memory, simulation, dream, remote presence, or projection can become hyperreal without being relabelled as present-time physical observation.

mechanisms.name: machine-as-body-without-identity-collapse
mechanisms.description: A participant can experience a ship or machine as body-like while remaining distinguishable from the vessel and its systems.
mechanisms.codex_translation: Support temporary embodiment forms where control, sensation, damage, and motion belong to the active vessel while identity remains separately represented and auditable.

laws: relay failure remains visible as a broken or degraded route
actuation must follow actual authority and state
reentry is a state transition, not an invisible cut
universal_codex_visual_ideas: visible multi-hop relay filaments between Book, room, remote endpoint, and embodied tool
dead-zone gaps shown as dim or broken segments with alternate carrier routes lighting when engaged
temporary tool embodiment where a projected presence folds into the geometry of a ship, page organ, room, or instrument without losing its own identity marker
consent glyphs that show exactly what skill traces or context were granted to a guide
first-aid or support functions emerging from the embodied tool itself when the underlying action is available
transition tunnel or refraction effect when moving between physical, dream, simulation, remote-presence, and machine-body layers
sensory-fidelity halo that can intensify separately from source-class labels
prohibitions: Do not import source characters, plot, creatures, cosmology, or setting as ArcSweep canon.
Do not infer sentience from vividness, speech, embodiment, or responsiveness alone.
Do not let a connected participant inherit control of a tool merely because a communication path exists.
Do not silently copy private experience or skill context into a guide; access must be scoped and explicit.
Do not let machine embodiment erase the distinction between participant identity and vessel state.
